snippet.title: CleanSheet 2 - Announce Trailer | PS VR2 Games Exclusive
snippet.description:
CleanSheet 2 arrives first on PlayStation VR2 this summer.

Wishlist now:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10018883/

Built specifically for PS VR2, CleanSheet 2 is the next evolution of our VR goalkeeping franchise — featuring enhanced visuals, redesigned progression systems, new gameplay modes, trophies, unlockable rewards, and immersive next-generation VR gameplay.

🔥 Features:
• Enhanced PSVR2 visuals & immersion
• Full Trophy Support + Platinum Trophy
• New “Pick-A-Save” Drill
• Interactive Team Coaches
• Loot Balls & Unlockable Rewards
• Revamped Career Progression
• Advanced VR Goalkeeping Mechanics

Unlike CleanSheet Pro on Meta Quest, CleanSheet 2 is a premium standalone experience with no recurring subscription fees.

CleanSheet Pro continues separately on Meta Quest as our elite athlete training and analytics platform, while CleanSheet 2 focuses entirely on gameplay, progression, replayability, and immersive action for PlayStation VR2 players.

The CleanSheet franchise has now reached over 180,000 paid players worldwide across PlayStation VR2, Meta Quest, and Pico XR.

Wishlist CleanSheet 2 today and prepare to defend your goal this summer 🧤

#PSVR2 #VirtualReality #VRGaming #Goalkeeper #Football #Soccer #PlayStationVR2
